title: Contact
intro: We are located at Harvard Medical School and welcome inquiries from prospective trainees, collaborators, and colleagues.
location_description: Our lab is based at Harvard Medical School in Boston and is part of a vibrant scientific community with strengths in immunology, translational medicine, and collaborative discovery.
application_intro: We welcome inquiries from scientists at different training stages. Please review the information below and reach out by email with materials tailored to your interests and goals.

application_paths.instructions: Please email a CV, a brief description of your research background and interests, and contact information for references.
